```{r custom functions, include=F}
generate_gsea_dot_plot <- function(dataset_list, cell_type_names) {
  # This function generates a dot plot visualising GSEA results for a collection of cell types.
  #   Dot colour will represent the NES, dot size the BH-adjusted P value. If the NES is NA, a dot
  #   is grey. If the P value is NA, the dot is replaced by an x. The y axis harbours the gene sets,
  #   the x axis harbours the cell types.
  # dataset_list: A list of data frames with the columns "pathway", "NES" and "padj_BH. Each element
  #   is considered to correspond to one cell type.
  # cell_type_names: Character; The names of the cell types that should appear in the plots. The order
  #   must correspond to the order of the dataset_list.
  # plot_outfile_pdf: Character; Path to a PDF file where the plot will be saved.
  # plot_outfilr_rds: Character; Path to an RDS file where the plot will be saved.
  # plot_width: Numeric; The width of the plot.
  # plot_height: Numeric; The hieght of the plot.
  # Dependency: ggplot2
  # Value: None; the function just generates and saves the dot plot.
  # Authore: Niklas Beumer

  # Add the cell type ID to each cell-type-specific data set.
  # Also add information on whether the P value is NA.
  # Also compute negative logarithms of the BH-adjusted P values.
  gsea_res_w_id <- lapply(1:length(dataset_list), FUN = function(x) {
    dataset <- dataset_list[[x]]
    dataset$id <- cell_type_names[x]
    dataset$pval_na <- sapply(dataset$padj_BH, FUN = function(y) { is.na(y) })
    dataset$logp <- (-1) * log10(dataset$padj_BH)
    return(dataset)
  })

  # Combine the cell-type-specific data sets.
  gsea_res_comb <- do.call(rbind, gsea_res_w_id)
  gsea_res_comb$id <- factor(gsea_res_comb$id, levels = cell_type_names)
  gsea_res_comb$pathway <- factor(gsea_res_comb$pathway, levels = rev(sort(unique(gsea_res_comb$pathway))))

  # Generate the dot plot.
  dot_plot <- ggplot(gsea_res_comb, aes(x = id, y = pathway, colour = NES, size = logp, shape = pval_na)) +
                        geom_point(stroke = 2) +
    viridis::scale_color_viridis() + 
    # scale_colour_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",limits = c(0, 0.15), midpoint = 0.075,
    #                        name = "Norm.\nenrichment\nscore", na.value = "black") +
    scale_shape_manual(breaks = c(T, F), values = c(4, 16)) +
    scale_size_area(na.value = 3) +
   
    guides(colour = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
           size = guide_legend(title = "-log10(q)", order = 2),
           shape = "none") +
    xlab("Group") +
    ylab("Gene set") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, colour = "black", hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 14),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

  dot_plot
  # Save the dot plot.
  # pdf(plot_outfile_pdf, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
  # print(dot_plot)
  # dev.off()
  # saveRDS(dot_plot, file = plot_outfile_rds)

}

add_line_breaks = function(charvec, max_nchar = 25, split_only_at = NULL){
  for(i in seq_along(charvec)){
    if(is.null(split_only_at)){
      charvec[i] = paste(strsplit(charvec[i], sprintf("(?<=.{%i})", max_nchar), perl = TRUE)[[1]], collapse = '\n')
    }else{
      str_subsets = strsplit(charvec[i], split_only_at)[[1]]
      new_str = str_subsets[1]
      str_subsets = str_subsets[-1]
      max_nchar_use = max_nchar
      while(length(str_subsets) > 0){
        if(nchar(paste(c(new_str, str_subsets[1]), collapse = split_only_at)) > max_nchar_use){
          col_val = '\n'
          max_nchar_use = max_nchar_use + max_nchar
        }else{
          col_val = split_only_at
        }
        new_str = paste(c(new_str, str_subsets[1]), collapse = col_val)
        str_subsets = str_subsets[-1]
      }
      charvec[i] = new_str
    }
  }
  charvec
}
```

```{r read gmt files, eval=run_go, include = F, echo = F}
#https://www.gsea-msigdb.org
if(config$species == 'mus musculus'){
  gmt_files = list.files(paste0(geneset_database,'Mm/'), pattern = '.gmt$', full.names = T)
  names(gmt_files) = gsub('^(.*).Mm.*$','\\1', basename(gmt_files))
  message(sprintf('Reading gmt files from %s:\n%s', paste0(geneset_database,'Mm/'), paste(basename(gmt_files), collapse = '\n')))
}else if(config$species == 'homo sapiens'){
  gmt_files = list.files(paste0(geneset_database,'Hs/'), pattern = '.gmt$', full.names = T)
  names(gmt_files) = gsub('^(.*).Hs.*$','\\1', basename(gmt_files))
  message(sprintf('Reading gmt files from %s:\n%s', paste0(geneset_database,'Hs/'), paste(basename(gmt_files), collapse = '\n')))
}

go_list <- lapply(gmt_files, clusterProfiler::read.gmt)
```

```{r loaddata, eval=make_plots, echo=F}
#todo: make data loading generic so it also works for scATAC
obj <- readRDS(file.path(analysis_dir, config[[obj_use]]))
pt_size = get_point_size(ncol(obj))
dr_df = jj_get_reduction_coords(obj, umap_use)
stopifnot(clusters %in% colnames(dr_df))
```


```{r find all markers, echo=F, eval = T, message=F}
Idents(obj) = obj@meta.data[, clusters]
# Find Markers which differ between on versus all other clusters
marker_df <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

marker_list <- marker_df %>%
  dplyr::relocate(gene) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::group_split(cluster)
marker_list <- lapply(marker_list,function(x) as.data.frame(x))
names(marker_list)<- underscore(levels(Idents(obj)))

# Output list of marker genes per cluster
outname <- sprintf('%s/%s_%s_all_markers.xlsx', config$outputpath$table, obj_use, gsub(' |/|\\.', '_', clusters))

WriteXLS(marker_list,
         ExcelFileName = file.path(analysis_dir, outname),
         SheetNames=names(marker_list), #inserts Sheet_1 instead of '0' for Cluster 0
         col.names = TRUE,
         AdjWidth = TRUE,
         BoldHeaderRow = TRUE)

config$all_markers = outname
write_yaml(config,file=params$config)
```

```{r marker feature overlap, echo = F}
jj_plot_upsetr(upset_list) 
```

## Heatmaps/Dotplot per group
### Single-cell heatmap

Plot the top markers by avg_lof2FC for each group in a cell sample of 2500 cells.

```{r plot single-cell heatmap, echo = F, message = F, eval = make_plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=5+length(unique(top10_df$gene))/10}
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = F)
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = unique(top10_df$gene), verbose = F)
cellsamp<-sample(ncol(obj),min(ncol(obj), 2500),replace = F)
DoHeatmap(obj, cells=cellsamp, features = unique(top10_df$gene)) + NoLegend()
```

### Per-cluster heatmap

Get the mean expression of the top markers for each group and scale each feature.

```{r plot group heatmap, echo = F, message = F, warning = F, eval = make_plots,  fig.width=12, fig.height=5+length(unique(top10_df$gene))/10}
gmat = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
jj_plot_heatmap(gmat, features_use =  top10_df$gene, cluster_rows = F, cluster_columns = F, group_vec = obj@meta.data[[clusters]], transpose = T)
```

### Per-cluster dotplot

Plot the top markers for each group as dotplot to additionally show the fraction of cells with detected gene expression.

```{r plot group dotplot, echo = F, message = F, warning = F, eval = make_plots,  fig.width=12, fig.height=5+length(unique(top10_df$gene))/10}
plot_dotplot(gmat, top10_df$gene,group_vec = obj@meta.data[[clusters]], cluster_columns = F, cluster_rows = F, scale_data = T, cap_top = 'q98')
```

## GO enrichment analysis {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}

```{r run go, eval = run_go, echo = F}
go_res_list = list()
for(i in seq_along(upset_list)){
  #message(i, '/', length(upset_list))
  go_res_list[[i]] = lapply(go_list, function(x) {
    enricher(
      gene = upset_list[[i]],
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      minGSSize = 10,
      maxGSSize = 500,
      qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
      TERM2GENE = x)
    }
  )
}
names(go_res_list) = names(upset_list)
go_unlist = lapply(unlist(go_res_list), function(x) x@result)
if(length(go_unlist) == 0){
  warning('No GO results were obtained. Wrong reference genome specified in config.yaml?')
  run_go = FALSE
}else{
  names(go_unlist) = paste(rep(names(upset_list), each = length(go_list)), names(go_list), sep = "__")
go_unlist = lapply(go_unlist, function(x) x[, colnames(x) %in% c('ID','GeneRatio','BgRatio','pvalue','p.adjust','qvalue','geneID','Count')])

outfile = file.path(analysis_dir, paste0(config$outputpath$table, "/go_results.xlsx"))
message('Writing GO results to ', outfile)
WriteXLS(go_unlist,
         ExcelFileName = outfile,
         SheetNames=names(go_unlist),
         col.names = TRUE,
         AdjWidth = TRUE,
         BoldHeaderRow = TRUE)
}

```

```{r prepare dotplots, include = F, eval = run_go}
ggl = list()
for(i in seq_along(go_res_list)){
  gg = list()
  for(j in seq_along(go_res_list[[i]])){
     if(length(go_res_list[[i]][[j]]) > 0){
      temp_res = go_res_list[[i]][[j]]@result
      temp_res$qvalue[is.na(temp_res$qvalue)] = temp_res$p.adjust[is.na(temp_res$qvalue)] #qval is NA if only 1 result -> fix by setting padjusted as qvalue
      if(sum(temp_res$p.adjust < 0.05 & temp_res$qvalue < 0.2) > 0){
        gg[[ names(go_res_list[[i]])[j] ]] = dotplot(go_res_list[[i]][[j]], showCategory = 15, font.size = 8 )
      }
    }
  }
  ggl[[names(go_res_list)[i] ]] = gg
}
```

```{r plot dotplots, results='asis', fig.width = 12, fig.height = 10, eval = run_go, echo = F}
for(j in seq_along(ggl)){
  cat("### ", names(ggl)[j], " {.tabset}\n")
  for(i in seq_along(ggl[[j]])){
    cat("#### ", names(ggl[[j]])[i], "\n")
    print(ggl[[j]][[i]])
    cat('\n\n')
  }
}
```


## Combined gene set dotplot {.tabset}

Create an overview of unique and shared enriched gene sets between the groups. The number of pathways is limited to 50 currently (top x results by p-value ranking per group are selected until a combined number of < 51 pathways is reached). 

```{r generate combined dotplot, include=F, eval = run_go}
dp_list = list()
for(j in names(go_list)){
  #for the collection j, get the data.frame with enriched gene sets for each cluster as a list
  common_collection_list = go_unlist[grepl(j, names(go_unlist))]
  for(i in seq_along(common_collection_list)){
    common_collection = common_collection_list[[i]]
    common_collection$padj_BH = common_collection$qvalue
    common_collection$pathway = common_collection$ID
    common_collection$NES = sapply(strsplit(common_collection$GeneRatio, '/'), function(x) as.integer(x[1]) / as.integer(x[2]))
    common_collection = common_collection[common_collection$padj_BH < 0.05, ]
    common_collection = common_collection[common_collection$NES > 0.05, ]
    common_collection_list[[i]] = common_collection
  }
  common_collection_list = common_collection_list[sapply(common_collection_list, nrow) > 0]
  total_pathways = length(unique(unlist(sapply(common_collection_list, function(x) x$ID))))
  while(total_pathways > 50){
    new_head = max(sapply(common_collection_list, nrow)) -1
    common_collection_list = lapply(common_collection_list, head, new_head)
    total_pathways = length(unique(unlist(sapply(common_collection_list, function(x) x$ID))))
  }
  
  common_collection_list = lapply(common_collection_list, function(x){
    x$pathway = add_line_breaks(x$pathway, max_nchar = 50, split_only_at = '_')
    x
  })
  
  dp_list[[j]] = generate_gsea_dot_plot(common_collection_list, cell_type_names = gsub('^(.*)__.*$','\\1',names(common_collection_list)))
  #save as png to avoid that long terms lead to squished dotplotgg
  ggsave(file.path(analysis_dir, sprintf("%s/plot_file_%s.png",config$outputpath$fig, j)), plot = dp_list[[j]],  width = 12, height = 3+0.2*nrow(dp_list[[j]]$data), limitsize = FALSE) #typically heihgt 11
}
#max(sapply(dp_list, function(x) nrow(x$data)))
```

```{r plot combined dotplot, results='asis', width = 12, height = 10, eval = run_go, echo = F}
for(j in seq_along(dp_list)){
  cat("### ", names(dp_list)[j], "\n")
  print(paste0('![](', file.path(analysis_dir, sprintf("%s/plot_file_%s.png",config$outputpath$fig, names(dp_list)[j])), ')'))
  cat('\n\n')
}
```
